Maria: AM check-in — quick update: synced with Emily on hero image and updated the content calendar with 3 new slots. Blocker: waiting on the final benchmark graphs from eng. Priority is the blog for Tue. @Josh can you confirm ETA for the visuals? :coffee:
Josh: Sent a draft results PNG to s3 earlier this morning: https://s3.redwood-inference.test/bench/17765/summary.png. CSV and raw logs coming in ~30m.
Maria: Awesome — can you also export an asset at 1200x600 for socials? Emily needs that size.
Emily: Yep, I'll do 1200x600 hero variants once I have the PNG. ETA ~45m. Swapping blue CTA to warm orange per the last design pass.
Sam: Drafted the blog intro + a 6-tweet thread. Google doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy... — placed it in the calendar slot 'Benchmark Highlights'. Need a quick copy pass after visuals land.
Josh: CSV and raw logs pushed to the doc now. Also added methodology note in the doc: ```batch_size=8
quant=4bit
kernel=amx_v2``` — ping me if you want the raw run command.
Maria: Blocker removed. Scheduling final review at 11:30 PT. @Sam please add a 1–2 line methodology blurb and tag Legal if we mention anything proprietary.
Sam: Will do. Quick Q: do we have approval to call out cost-per-token numbers? @Finance might need to weigh in.
BenchBot: Benchmark run #17765 complete. Artifacts uploaded: s3://bench/17765/{summary.png,results.csv,logs.tar.gz}.
Maria: Thanks everyone. If visuals + copy look good after the 11:30 review, I'll slot for Tuesday publish. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
